limitations: The forward covariance transform is classical and is not claimed as new. The novelty claim is restricted to the inverse equivalence-class formulation and the all-parameter phase-type Markov-mimicking construction. Full path or higher-order data can distinguish the models, and equivalent older inverse observations remain a residual originality risk.
scientific_summary: Stationary second-order data for a two-state alternating renewal process identify only the sum of the two renewal transforms. For every exponential/exponential two-state Markov chain, an explicit Erlang-2/hyperexponential non-Markov alternating renewal process has exactly the same stationary two-time distribution at every lag.
